quest.title: Saurian Sojourn
quest.description: One day, while visiting the Children of Echoes, you meet a couple of people...

dialogues.speaker: Komina
dialogues.text: Everything aside from the high-altitude training is now complete, sir.

dialogues.speaker: Kweku
dialogues.text: Excellent. You both sound ready to roll!

dialogues.speaker: Kweku
dialogues.text: The Children of Echoes will be the first strategic objective in our grand plan. After that, we'll systematically infiltrate the People of the Springs and the Scions of the Canopy...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Woah, woah, woah! What in the world are you talking about, Kweku?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sounds like you've started a shadowy espionage organization.

dialogues.speaker: Kweku
dialogues.text: #Huh? Looks like our hero, {NICKNAME}, and {M#his}{F#her} companion, Paimon, are here!

dialogues.speaker: Kweku
dialogues.text: Espionage organization? Ahahahaha! We're just here to share a few tips on how to have fun interactions with saurians.

dialogues.speaker: Kweku
dialogues.text: Komina is our on-site doctor. She'll go with our participants to ensure their safety.

dialogues.speaker: Kweku
dialogues.text: And this is Assistant Instructor Yehyeh, who's helping out by special request. Yehyeh really came through for us when we were setting the stage objectives!

dialogues.speaker: Kweku
dialogues.text: As for me, well, I'm the Chief Instructor — to put it simply, I'm the organizer. You caught me giving the team a little pep talk just now...

choices.text: Thank goodness it was all a misunderstanding...

response.speaker: Komina
response.text: I'm sorry, it's all my fault! When I heard that Mr. Kweku was engaged in such a meaningful undertaking, I suggested he adopt more "formal" language to describe it... I guess that suggestion backfired.

response.speaker: Kweku
response.text: Ha! No need to apologize, Miss Komina. Both Assistant Instructor Yehyeh and I love the titles you've come up with for us. Isn't that so, Assistant Instructor Yehyeh?

response.speaker: Kweku
response.text: #See? ...Oh, by the way, would you like to give these stages a try too, {NICKNAME}? They might be a little easy for you, but you should still find them interesting.

response.speaker: Kweku
response.text: It's really simple — you work together with various saurians to complete the objectives we've set. The most important thing here is trust and teamwork between you and your saurian companions.

response.speaker: Kweku
response.text: You won't be able to complete all the objectives on your own, so make sure to pay close attention to your saurian companions at all times.

response.speaker: Kweku
response.text: Oh, and one more thing — we won't be traveling with the qucusaurs this time, as we don't have the necessary high-altitude safety gear just yet. Safety is our number one priority, after all!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: #Woohoo! Let's give it a go, {NICKNAME}! You're the master of working with others!

response.speaker: Komina
response.text: #Awesome... If word gets out that {NICKNAME} is here, everyone will want to have a go!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Huh? Then shouldn't Komina give us a "formal" title, too? You know, something formidable-sounding, hehe...

response.speaker: Komina
response.text: Well, I'm going to have to think this over carefully...

choices.text: I was this close to reporting you...
